short_summary: Iterates through a hardcoded table in the data section, conditionally accumulating 16-bit field values from a provided structure based on bit flags.
detailed_summary: The function performs a loop over a table of 39 entries (progressing through 39 iterations from byte_41B178 up to the string 'dPF<2' at 0x0041BCF4 with a stride of 0x3C bytes). In each iteration, it checks a bit flag located at the current table pointer. If the low bit is set, it extracts two 16-bit values from offsets [edx] and [edx+0x62] of the input structure pointer passed in edx (which is pre-adjusted by adding 0x14), adds them together along with an accumulating sum, and updates the sum in eax. The input structure pointer (edx) is incremented by 2 on each iteration.

parameters.name: edx_struct_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a data structure (accessed with offsets like +0x14, +0x16, +0x76, etc. due to the loop increments).
